Lv 1
Level up

Compound

You are a place that hazards keep arriving at. Aiming and firing are automatic. You cannot stop them coming — you can only decide what you build, and how fast. WASD to move, SPACE to evacuate.

Risk is local. Choose where you are.

How fast does this place grow?

Art credits

Most of the pictures in this game come from 45 art packs by other artists. Thank you to all of them. The game draws the other pictures itself. For each pack you can see who made it, where to find it, its licence, what was changed and where you see it in the game. Some changes happen only in play: the pictures of hazards and compound events on the map flash white when they are hit and turn grey when they are held. Links open in a new tab.

Share-alike images

Seventeen images in this game were made from share-alike art. Share-alike means that anyone may use and change these images if they give credit and share their own changed versions under the same licence. Sixteen of these images are licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. One, the Storm picture, is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Full LPC credits

Three of the LPC packs ask that every author in their credits file be credited. Here is every entry of those files, word for word. A fourth pack, LPC Tile Atlas, points to its own attribution file; the nine names in it follow.
